welcome.title: Getting started
welcome.body: Your schedule, blackout times, lesson notes and invoices in one place. Everything stays on this device: nothing is sent to Tutorcat or anyone else.
welcome.step1: Add your name and payment details in Settings (they go on your invoices).
welcome.step2: Add your students, with their time zone and rate.
welcome.step3: Book lessons (one-off or weekly) and block the times you're not available.
welcome.step4: After each lesson, note what you covered. Invoices build themselves from your lessons.
firstRun.title: Welcome to Tutorcat Desk
firstRun.lead: Your schedule, blackout times, lesson notes and invoices, in one place.
firstRun.free: Tutorcat Desk is free for tutors listed on Tutorcat.
firstRun.apply: Apply on Tutorcat's For tutors page
firstRun.dataTitle: Your data stays on this device
firstRun.data: There's no account, and nothing you type is sent to Tutorcat or anyone else. Back up from Settings now and then: the backup file brings everything back if this browser is cleared, or on a new laptop.
sample.showing: You're looking at sample data (Sara A. and Omar K.).
sample.removeBody: The sample students, their lessons and anything you made for them (notes, invoices) will be deleted. Your own data stays.
sample.saraNotes: Strong at algebra; needs practice with geometry proofs. IGCSE exam in May.
sample.omarNotes: Aiming for 750+ in SAT Math. Likes worked examples first.
sample.covered: Solved simultaneous equations by elimination and substitution. Good progress.
sample.note: Print the IGCSE past paper for Sara

install.title: Install the app
install.done: Installed. Open Tutorcat Desk from your Start menu, Dock or home screen; it works offline.
install.intro: Install Tutorcat Desk to open it in its own window, like any app on your laptop. It works offline.
install.safari: In Safari: File → Add to Dock.
install.ios: Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
install.other: In Chrome or Edge, use the install icon in the address bar (or the browser menu → Install Tutorcat Desk).
data.title: Your data
data.private: Everything you type here stays in this browser on this device. Nothing is sent to Tutorcat or anyone else. WhatsApp only opens when you press a WhatsApp button, with a message you check before sending.
data.notPersisted: the browser may clear it if storage runs low
data.backupIntro: A backup is one file with everything. Keep it somewhere safe (your own cloud drive or a USB stick), and use it to move to a new laptop.
data.deleteBody: All students, lessons, notes, blackouts, invoices and settings will be deleted from this browser. This can't be undone unless you have a backup.
